outcome: recovery from obstetric fistula repair surgery
cohort: 224 women who had obstetric fistula repair surgery in Northern Ethiopia
finding: Vaginal scarring, age older than 30 years, facility and spontaneous vaginal delivery, first attempt repair, and shorter duration of catheterization were independent predictors of recovery time from obstetric fistula repair.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery (facility vs. home) was an independent predictor of recovery from obstetric fistula repair, with facility births associated with longer recovery times.
followup_time: The median time to recovery was 15 days, but the total follow-up time isn't specified.
